chunks: Whatever is in it from Muḥammad ibn Muslim al-Thaqafī, I have transmitted it from ʿAlī ibn Aḥmad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh, from his father, from his grandfather Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh al-Barqī, from his father Muḥammad ibn Khālid, from al-ʿAlāʾ ibn Razīn, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim.
ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh for narrations from Muḥammad ibn Muslim al-Thaqafī?
ai.summary: This passage is a sanad/isnad notice identifying the transmission chain for narrations in the book that come through Muḥammad ibn Muslim al-Thaqafī. Its significance lies in documenting the route of transmission, which is important in hadith sciences and the verification of reports.
